description: Update core theme system: CSS variables in globals.css for light theme palette, remove 'dark' class from layout.tsx html element, verify shadcn/ui components render correctly with new variables
steps: Read src/app/globals.css and identify all CSS variables in :root that define the dark theme (background, foreground, card, popover, primary, secondary, muted, accent, destructive, border, input, ring)

Replace CSS variables with light theme palette: --background: 0 0% 100% (white), --foreground: 222.2 84% 4.9% (dark text), --card: 0 0% 100%, --card-foreground: 222.2 84% 4.9%, --popover: 0 0% 100%, --popover-foreground: 222.2 84% 4.9%, --primary: 221.2 83.2% 53.3% (indigo-600), --primary-foreground: 210 40% 98%, --secondary: 210 40% 96.1% (slate-100), --secondary-foreground: 222.2 47.4% 11.2%, --muted: 210 40% 96.1%, --muted-foreground: 215.4 16.3% 46.9%, --accent: 210 40% 96.1%, --accent-foreground: 222.2 47.4% 11.2%, --destructive: 0 84.2% 60.2%, --destructive-foreground: 210 40% 98%, --border: 214.3 31.8% 91.4%, --input: 214.3 31.8% 91.4%, --ring: 221.2 83.2% 53.3%
Open src/app/layout.tsx and remove className='dark' from the html element, keeping only lang='en'
Verify: run 'npm run build' to ensure TypeScript compilation succeeds with no errors
acceptance_criteria: globals.css :root section contains light theme CSS variable values
layout.tsx html element has no 'dark' className
npm run build completes successfully with exit code 0
findings: CSS variables updated to light theme palette and className='dark' removed from html element. TypeScript compilation and linting successful. Note: Build encounters pre-existing runtime errors during static page generation (PageNotFoundError for _document, Cannot read properties errors on /auth/login and /). These are unrelated to theme changes and should be investigated separately.
